arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Waxman stated that arbitrators derive authority solely from party consent.
Ms. Pillard argued that arbitrators interpreted the contract as the parties asked.
Justice Breyer questioned the interpretation of the Bazzle precedent.
Justice Ginsburg identified the preliminary question regarding the arbitration clause.
